facts.fact: Nash 宣布石头的真规则：Brinden Stone 只回应真正的指挥压力、非幸运石——错手是灾难；因此要试炼
facts.anchor: they only respond under true command strain

facts.fact: 第二枚石=已故 Corwin 将军的遗产（黑椭圆、死后寻回），无 Lithic 验真——不 bond 则下轮优先补发
facts.anchor: witnesses have assumed it’s Corwin’s based on the nature of the stone

facts.fact: 挑战四要件：五人成功渡河、证人回诉、可复现、零伤亡、离开后仍可用；三天时限、资源合法与否不论
facts.anchor: Your route must be repeatable. It must result in no casualties. And it must remain viable once you leave

facts.fact: 抢人战：她授权 Icarus 代选队员（「你接我的位子」）并亲点 Ursa 新兵 Rokin 为向导；Alden 带 Draymor；对 Alden 喊「你不会是第三名」
facts.anchor: Icarus, you are my second, and you will take my place when I am ascended.

facts.fact: cottage 行装站：Draven+Mildred 帮卸甲；Draven 递自己的钢 laguncula+额吻+军令式祝语——她心里有了 storm 与 calm 的定位句
facts.anchor: Come back safe. It’s an order.

facts.fact: 队员公投：Blight 打头阵（「缺自我保存意识」正合适）；队伍=Icarus/Hellbore（新鹰 Niobe，旧鹰一年前传信未归）/Areneas/Peltin+Blight 兄弟/Fragon（Speckle 满尾战结）/Rokin
facts.anchor: they have all decided Blight must be the first to cross

facts.fact: Hellbore 的鹰事：Niobe 年轻初学寻路，这是她离首都最远的一次放飞——铁血 Ironhide 的温柔角落
黄昏抵达：Rokin 找到祖父渔舍附近的河段——坦白没把握、怕让她失望；她回赠「I believed in you」；Vine 河声如持续轰鸣宣告存在
facts.anchor: I didn’t know if I could find it from the direction we came
